notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached or run. The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver shape fits: GymHabitatEnv is a gym.Wrapper, and the bridge derives cap.world.step/reset/seed from the environment spaces. env_id is Habitat-v0 with cfg_file_path=pointnav_habitat_test.yaml, a registration the clone's own tests use (test/test_gym_wrapper.py:141-148); the upstream class remains the card's entry symbol habitat.core.environments:GymHabitatEnv. The sim backend (gym.make(Habitat-v0, cfg_file_path=...)) was NOT run: habitat-sim, the habitat_test dataset and legacy gym 0.22 are not installed here. The fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic point-navigation stand-in (fake.py); it was never compared with habitat-sim or a real run. NOT COVERED: the full 256x256x3 rgb and 256x256x1 depth observations that the point-nav test config declares (pointnav_habitat_test.yaml:14-20); the fake returns 12- and 4-number flat stand-ins, named in the fidelity gaps and in driver.py as 12- and 4-number stand-ins. NOT COVERED: habitat-sim rigid-body dynamics, contacts, the articulated arm, rendering, the slack/success rewards and the physics timestep; the fidelity contract therefore declares F0, kinematic, event-driven, timestep_ms 0, and lists these gaps. The fake accepts reset(seed=...) so the gateway's seeded path is exercised; the legacy upstream wrapper seeds through env.seed() instead (habitat/core/env.py:481-482) and the bridge falls back to it on TypeError, which was not exercised against habitat-lab. Expected warnings on this family and package: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed is applied to the next reset, no native call), five G7.MAYBE_ABSENT for reset/step/close/action_space/observation_space (GymHabitatEnv inherits the Gym API from the external gym.Wrapper base, which the clone does not define), and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.index and seed twice. G4 had no warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used; there are no extension ids and no catalogue requests. No site-limits.example.json is needed: the device is simulated R0 and the action space is the only bound.
